items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday vs. Bears. Rapoport corroborated Hall OUT along with other Jets.
items.why: Quad injury from Week 3; official Friday designation.
items.implication: Jets RB1 out; backfield shifts to backups with full opportunity.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps/carries/routes for handcuff(s) vs Bears.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels officially out Sunday. Rapoport: Dan Quinn made official Marcus Mariota starts again vs Colts.
items.why: Left elbow dislocation recovery; not ready.
items.implication: Mariota starts; Commanders pass game and rush upside change.
items.opportunity: Mariota volume vs Colts defense allowing high QB PPG.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on injured reserve due to hamstring injury. Out at least 4 games (eligible Week 9 post-bye).
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Week 3; significant enough for IR.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/carries for remaining RBs; committee but elevated roles.

items.text: Caleb Williams ruled out (hamstring). Swift expected to practice; Ben Johnson optimistic on Swift after MNF effects.
items.why: Hamstring strain continuing; Swift recovering MNF.
items.implication: Bears backup QB starts vs Jets; Swift likely plays.
items.opportunity: Bears RB/WR volume stable if Swift active; QB downgrade.

items.text: With Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has 13.8% target share (was 8.3% with Sampson healthy). On pace for 64 catches (26 last year in 14 games). Only 4-game sample but solid usage spike.
items.why: Teammate absence driving higher target share/pace.
items.implication: Elevated PPR floor/ceiling as pass-catching RB.

items.text: Not much optimism Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays Sunday vs Rams; expectation he won’t go. Schefter notes Rams get Nacua back as Eagles prepare without Smith.
items.why: Hamstring; sidelined this week, sources low optimism.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thins; targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Eagles pass-catchers.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): Led all RBs 90% snap rate last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out again. CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Top-10 play.
items.why: Workhorse usage short week + favorable matchup.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career tgt share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return. NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.opportunity: High target share, red-zone with Penix.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: Mitchell likely out again; Wilson 36% tgt share last without him. 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ yds/rec.
Rams HC Sean McVay expects WR Puka Nacua (groin/hip) to play Sunday vs Eagles. Full participant Thursday; Schefter/Rap context of return.
items.why: Progress to full practice; McVay expectation.
items.implication: Rams WR1 returns; Adams/others may see slight dip but high total.
items.opportunity: Nacua routes/targets/red-zone vs Eagles without Smith.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: 16% career tgt share/34 ypg with Penix; <8 FP in 9/13 such games; TE37 utilization. Levitan: 6 tgts through 3 games, none inside 10, low aDOT; underperformed opportunity.
items.why: Persistent low usage/aDOT with Penix; data confirms.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% tgt, 25% routes; snap rate dropped to 42% W3, 13% third-down. SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Declining role + tough run defense matchup.

items.text: LOVE Josh Downs vs WSH: 31% tgt last two, 43% red-zone looks; WSH most FP to WRs/most slot TDs. LOVE George Kittle vs DEN: climbing tgt/routes (27% W3); Evans day-to-day ribs; DEN 8th-most TE yds.
items.why: Volume/red-zone + matchup; Kittle role expansion if Evans limited.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone share; Kittle routes up.

items.text: Fresh ETR ROS Top-150 live (Half-PPR): Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall. Other notables Parker Washington 22, Saquon Barkley 30. Trade calculator updated.
items.implication: Walker elite ROS asset; hold/buy high.
